name: cooling_coil_with_control_simplified
title: Cooling coil with control, simplified model (contact temperature)
summary: Simplified cooling and dehumidifying coil of an air handling unit from the ULiège model bank: the refrigerant side is not modelled and the coil is represented by a contact temperature (approach fraction set by the contact-factor effectiveness), driven by a bounded proportional control law on the exhaust air temperature; computes the exhaust air state and the total, sensible and latent cooling powers.

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), simplified model with control, 2008-01-16; published as Lemort, Cuevas, Lebrun, Teodorese, ASHRAE Transactions 114(1), 2008

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (34 variables) against the native file cooling_coil_with_control_simplified.eescode (the native file is the verified file)
verification.notes: 34 common variables, 14 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 2.71e-02 (Q_dot_latent_coolingcoil, 6948.13 W against 7141.41 W): a residual of two large numbers. Cause: the EES and CoolProp humid-air formulations (dew point 3.9e-03, wet-bulb 2.3e-03, W_c 4.2e-03, h_a_ex 2.0e-03), as in the other humid-air models of the library (CSL-0070 4.4e-03, CSL-0016 5.1e-03). The algebraic results are reproduced exactly or below 1e-05 (t_a_ex, t_c, Q_dot_sensible, t_c_mindry). No variable excluded. The native file, with the EES 5-argument IF (CS-GAP-IF5 closed in CoolSolve fix/library-gaps-2 @59b2862), solves in 2 iterations and gives the same 34 values as the former _coolsolve variant (identical .sol), which was removed.
